annotations.title: Option price, greeks and implied volatility

description: Option price, greeks and implied volatility — Black-Scholes-Merton option pricer with dividend yield: call and put value, delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho, breakeven, intrinsic/time value, risk-neutral probability ITM, 1-sd expected move and put-call parity. Pass price= with type=call|put to solve implied volatility instead of vol=. style=american uses a 300-step binomial tree. Params: spot, strike, days (or expiry=YYYY-MM-DD), vol (annual %), optional rate (% default 4), div (%), type (call|put|both), price, style. Offline. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_option_price
